signal: Smartcar expanded its connected-vehicle API platform with a Volvo Cars partnership across the US and Europe, opening new enterprise use cases in energy, insurance, and fleet

email.body1:
Madeline, saw Smartcar expanded coverage with the Volvo partnership across the US and Europe.

New OEM coverage opens up enterprise buyers in energy, insurance, and fleet faster than an enterprise team can personally work them, and that is where deals stall before a rep ever reaches out. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Smartcar off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Madeline, quick follow-up for Smartcar.

As new verticals open behind the Volvo expansion, the gap is usually knowing how many meetings the team needs to convert that wider TAM. Most teams find out late, and by then the quarter is a recovery effort.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Smartcar needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Madeline, last bit of proof for Smartcar.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Smartcar's reply rate likely compares to similar API platform startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Madeline, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Expansion timing is everything, and I know opening new verticals is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise motion? I will tailor it to Smartcar either way.
